natural: Soaring straight up on a whirlwind

meaning.en: To rise rapidly (in career or value); to skyrocket.
meaning.zh: 形容仕途得意，迅速高升；也形容价格等迅速上涨。

examples.zh: 他进入公司后扶摇直上，五年就当上了副总。
examples.en: He had a meteoric rise at the company, becoming vice-president within five years.

examples.zh: 房价扶摇直上，年轻人买不起房。
examples.en: House prices have gone through the roof, and young people can't afford homes.

story.en: Zhuangzi's giant bird Peng "beats the whirlwind and rises ninety thousand li" (抟扶摇而上者九万里).
story.zh: 《庄子·逍遥游》写大鹏"抟扶摇而上者九万里"。

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

natural: Sharing the autumn scenery equally

meaning.en: To share equally; to be evenly matched.
meaning.zh: 比喻双方各得一半，不分上下。

examples.zh: 两队平分秋色，以一比一战平。
examples.en: Honours were even as the teams drew one-all.

examples.zh: 两家公司平分秋色，各占一半市场。
examples.en: The two companies split the market fifty-fifty.

story.en: Li Pu's Mid-Autumn poem: "The full moon shares the autumn scene equally" (平分秋色一轮满) — since mid-autumn falls in the middle of the season.
story.zh: 李朴《中秋》："平分秋色一轮满，长伴云衢千里明。"

natural: Fallen leaves return to the roots

meaning.en: To return to one's roots or homeland in old age.
meaning.zh: 比喻事物有一定的归宿，多指客居他乡的人终究要回到本乡。

examples.zh: 在海外生活了四十年，他决定落叶归根。
examples.en: After forty years abroad, he decided to return to his roots.

examples.zh: 很多老华侨都有落叶归根的愿望。
examples.en: Many elderly overseas Chinese wish to return to their homeland.

story.en: The Sixth Patriarch Huineng, about to return to his birthplace to die, said: "Leaves fall and return to the root" (叶落归根).
story.zh: 六祖慧能将回故乡圆寂，说："叶落归根，来时无口。"

usage.zh: 多作谓语。也作"叶落归根"。

synonyms: 胡马依北风，越鸟巢南枝
antonyms: 灶王爷贴在腿肚子上——人走家搬

natural: Every minute and second must be fought for

meaning.en: Every second counts.
meaning.zh: 一分一秒也一定要争取。形容抓紧时间。

examples.zh: 救援工作分秒必争。
examples.en: In rescue work every second counts.

examples.zh: 离截止日期只剩一天，大家分秒必争。
examples.en: With one day to the deadline, everyone is racing against time.

natural: Looking at each other's faces

meaning.en: To look at each other in blank dismay.
meaning.zh: 你看我，我看你，不知如何是好。形容惊惧或无可奈何的样子。

equivalents: look at each other in dismay

examples.zh: 听到这个坏消息，大家面面相觑，一时说不出话。
examples.en: Hearing the bad news, everyone exchanged blank looks, lost for words.

examples.zh: 老师提问后，同学们面面相觑，没人举手。
examples.en: After the teacher's question, the students looked at each other and no one raised a hand.

natural: Not even a crow or sparrow making a sound

meaning.en: Utterly silent; you could hear a pin drop.
meaning.zh: 连乌鸦和麻雀的声音都没有。形容非常静。

equivalents: you could hear a pin drop

examples.zh: 考场里鸦雀无声。
examples.en: You could hear a pin drop in the exam hall.

examples.zh: 他话音刚落，会场里顿时鸦雀无声。
examples.en: The moment he finished speaking, the hall fell dead silent.

usage.en: Predicate. Very common in school writing.

natural: Standing gracefully like jade

meaning.en: Slender and graceful (of a young woman or a plant).
meaning.zh: 形容女子身材修长或花木形体挺拔。

examples.zh: 几年不见，她已长成亭亭玉立的少女。
examples.en: In just a few years she's grown into a slender, graceful young woman.

examples.zh: 池塘里的荷花亭亭玉立。
examples.en: The lotus flowers stand gracefully in the pond.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Young women, flowers, trees.

natural: Raising an army and mobilising the masses

meaning.en: To make a big fuss; to mobilise lots of people (often unnecessarily).
meaning.zh: 原指大规模出兵。现多指动用很多人力做某件事。

equivalents: make a big production of it
go to a lot of trouble
use a sledgehammer to crack a nut

examples.zh: 一点小事，不必兴师动众。
examples.en: It's a small matter — no need to make a big production of it.

examples.zh: 为了迎接检查，单位兴师动众地大扫除。
examples.en: To prepare for the inspection, the whole unit was mobilised for a big clean-up.

usage.en: Predicate. Usually critical. 兴 is xīng.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多含贬义。"兴"读 xīng。

natural: Pointed at by a thousand people

meaning.en: Universally condemned.
meaning.zh: 被众人所指责。

examples.zh: 这种不道德的行为必然千夫所指。
examples.en: Such unethical behaviour is bound to be universally condemned.

examples.zh: 他一夜之间成了千夫所指的对象。
examples.en: Overnight he became the target of public outrage.

story.en: Wang Jia warned the emperor about a favourite: "When a thousand people point at someone, he dies without illness" (千人所指，无病而死).
story.zh: 《汉书·王嘉传》："里谚曰：'千人所指，无病而死。'"

natural: Seeing profit and forgetting what's right

meaning.en: To abandon principles at the sight of profit.
meaning.zh: 见到有利可图就忘了道义。

examples.zh: 他见利忘义，出卖了朋友。
examples.en: He sold out his friend for money.

examples.zh: 做生意不能见利忘义。
examples.en: In business you mustn't put profit before principle.

synonyms: 婴儿饿肚皮——有奶便是娘
antonyms: 富贵不能淫，贫贱不能移，威武不能屈
生，亦我所欲也；义，亦我所欲也；二者不可得兼，舍生而取义者也

natural: Going in and out of the jaws of death

meaning.en: To brave death repeatedly; to risk one's life.
meaning.zh: 原意是从出生到死去。后形容冒生命危险，不顾个人安危。

equivalents: go through hell and high water

examples.zh: 他们在战场上出生入死，结下了深厚的友谊。
examples.en: Braving death together on the battlefield, they forged a deep friendship.

examples.zh: 战地记者常常出生入死。
examples.en: War correspondents often risk their lives.

story.en: Laozi: "Coming out is life, going in is death" (出生入死) — originally simply the span from birth to death; later it came to mean braving death.
story.zh: 《老子》："出生入死。"原指从出生到死亡，后指冒生命危险。

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前6—前4世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 6th–4th c. BC

natural: The furnace flame burning pure blue

meaning.en: Consummate skill; perfection through long practice.
meaning.zh: 道家炼丹，炉中火焰呈纯青色时就成功了。比喻学问、技术或办事达到了纯熟完美的境界。

equivalents: at the top of one's game

examples.zh: 他的书法已达到炉火纯青的地步。
examples.en: His calligraphy has reached consummate perfection.

examples.zh: 经过多年练习，她的厨艺炉火纯青。
examples.en: After years of practice, her cooking is masterful.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. From Daoist alchemy: when the furnace flame turned pure blue-green, the elixir was ready.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。源自道家炼丹。

natural: Taking a sip and stopping

meaning.en: To give up after a superficial try; to dabble.
meaning.zh: 稍微尝试一下就停下来。指不深入钻研。

examples.zh: 学乐器不能浅尝辄止。
examples.en: You can't just dabble when learning an instrument.

examples.zh: 他对什么都浅尝辄止，没有一样精通。
examples.en: He dabbles in everything and masters nothing.

antonyms: 为学要如金字塔，要能广大要能高
世之奇伟、瑰怪、非常之观，常在于险远，而人之所罕至焉，故非有志者不能至也

natural: Strong in body and robust in strength

meaning.en: Strong and healthy; robust.
meaning.zh: 身体强壮，有力气。

examples.zh: 他身强力壮，一个人就把冰箱搬上了楼。
examples.en: He's so strong he carried the fridge upstairs on his own.

examples.zh: 年轻人身强力壮，要多干点。
examples.en: Young people are strong and healthy — they should do more.

natural: Smashing the cooking pots and sinking the boats

meaning.en: To burn one's bridges; to commit totally with no retreat.
meaning.zh: 比喻下定决心，不顾一切干到底。

examples.zh: 他辞掉工作，破釜沉舟地创业。
examples.en: He quit his job and burned his bridges to start his business.

examples.zh: 我们只有破釜沉舟，才能打赢这一仗。
examples.en: Only by committing totally can we win this battle.

story.en: Before the Battle of Julu, Xiang Yu crossed the river, then sank the boats, smashed the cooking pots and burned the camps, leaving three days' rations — his men fought to the death and crushed the Qin army.
story.zh: 巨鹿之战，项羽渡河后"皆沉船，破釜甑，烧庐舍，持三日粮"，士兵拼死作战，大破秦军。

synonyms: 舍得一身剐，敢把皇帝拉下马

natural: The true face of Mount Lu

meaning.en: The true nature of something; the real picture.
meaning.zh: 比喻事物的真相或人的本来面目。

examples.zh: 经过调查，这件事的庐山真面目终于揭开了。
examples.en: After the investigation, the true picture finally emerged.

examples.zh: 直到今天我才看清了他的庐山真面目。
examples.en: Only today did I see his true colours.

story.en: Su Shi's famous poem: "I can't see Mount Lu's true face, simply because I'm standing in the mountain" (不识庐山真面目，只缘身在此山中).
story.zh: 苏轼《题西林壁》："不识庐山真面目，只缘身在此山中。"

usage.en: Object, often 看清/揭开……的庐山真面目.

natural: Holding the piece up, unable to decide

meaning.en: Hesitant and indecisive.
meaning.zh: 拿着棋子，不知下哪一步好。比喻做事犹豫不决。

examples.zh: 选哪所大学，他至今举棋不定。
examples.en: He still can't decide which university to choose.

examples.zh: 关键时刻领导不能举棋不定。
examples.en: A leader can't waver at a critical moment.

story.en: A Wei official said: "A player who raises a piece without deciding will not beat his opponent" (弈者举棋不定，不胜其耦).
story.zh: 《左传》："弈者举棋不定，不胜其耦。"

natural: Tangled up and unclear

meaning.en: Hopelessly entangled; impossible to sort out.
meaning.zh: 纠缠在一起，弄不清楚。

examples.zh: 两家的债务关系纠缠不清。
examples.en: The two families' debts are hopelessly entangled.

examples.zh: 别在小事上纠缠不清。
examples.en: Don't get bogged down in trivia.

synonyms: 剪不断，理还乱，是离愁。别是一般滋味在心头

natural: Throwing out a brick to attract jade

meaning.en: To offer one's humble ideas to draw out better ones (modest).
meaning.zh: 抛出砖去，引回玉来。比喻用自己不成熟的意见或作品引出别人更好的意见或作品。

examples.zh: 我先说几句，抛砖引玉，希望大家多提意见。
examples.en: Let me get the ball rolling with a few thoughts — I hope everyone will chip in.

examples.zh: 这篇文章只是抛砖引玉。
examples.en: This article is just meant to start the discussion.

story.en: Legend says the poet Chang Jian, wanting a couplet from the better poet Zhao Gu, wrote the first two lines on a temple wall; Zhao finished it brilliantly. The idiom also became one of the Thirty-Six Stratagems.
story.zh: 相传常建想得到赵嘏的诗，先在寺壁题写两句，赵嘏见后续成全诗。后也是三十六计之一。

usage.en: Predicate. Self-deprecating; about one's own contribution.

natural: Thin as a stick of firewood

meaning.en: Skin and bones; extremely thin.
meaning.zh: 瘦得只剩骨头，像干柴一样。形容极瘦。

examples.zh: 他病了几个月，骨瘦如柴。
examples.en: After months of illness, he's skin and bones.

examples.zh: 那只流浪猫骨瘦如柴。
examples.en: The stray cat was a bag of bones.

natural: Songs of Chu on all four sides

meaning.en: Surrounded by enemies; isolated and beleaguered.
meaning.zh: 比喻四面受敌，处于孤立无援的境地。

equivalents: with one's back to the wall

examples.zh: 公司遭到多方起诉，陷入四面楚歌的境地。
examples.en: Sued from all sides, the company is besieged.

examples.zh: 他在会上四面楚歌，没有一个人支持他。
examples.en: At the meeting he was completely isolated, with no one supporting him.

story.en: Xiang Yu, besieged at Gaixia, heard Han soldiers singing Chu songs on all sides and thought all Chu had fallen. That night he sang his farewell to Lady Yu.
story.zh: 项羽被围垓下，"夜闻汉军四面皆楚歌"，以为楚地已失，于是作《垓下歌》与虞姬诀别。

natural: Head hanging and spirit lost

meaning.en: Dejected; crestfallen.
meaning.zh: 形容失意或受挫后情绪低落的样子。

examples.zh: 比赛输了，队员们垂头丧气地离开了球场。
examples.en: Having lost, the players left the pitch crestfallen.

examples.zh: 别垂头丧气的，下次再努力。
examples.en: Don't be down in the dumps — try harder next time.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. 丧 is sàng.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。"丧"读 sàng。

synonyms: 泄了气的皮球——一下子就瘪了
antonyms: 老当益壮，宁移白首之心；穷且益坚，不坠青云之志

natural: Loving the lofty and chasing the distant

meaning.en: To aim too high; to be unrealistically ambitious.
meaning.zh: 比喻不切实际地追求过高过远的目标。

equivalents: reach for the stars without a ladder
bite off more than one can chew

examples.zh: 刚毕业就想当总经理，太好高骛远了。
examples.en: Wanting to be CEO straight after graduating is aiming far too high.

examples.zh: 学习要脚踏实地，不能好高骛远。
examples.en: Study steadily — don't run before you can walk.

story.en: The Neo-Confucian Cheng Hao lamented that students "disdain what is lowly and near and chase what is lofty and far" (厌卑近而骛高远).
story.zh: 《宋史·程颢传》："病学者厌卑近而骛高远，卒无成焉。"

usage.en: Predicate. 好 is hào; 骛 is wù.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"好"读 hào，"骛"读 wù。

synonyms: 飞机上吹喇叭——响（想）得高

natural: Spirit as mighty as mountains and rivers

meaning.en: Magnificent and heroic; awe-inspiring.
meaning.zh: 形容气势像高山大河那样雄伟豪迈。

examples.zh: 英雄们气壮山河的事迹永远激励着后人。
examples.en: The heroes' epic deeds will forever inspire future generations.

examples.zh: 这首交响乐气壮山河。
examples.en: The symphony is stirring and majestic.

natural: A smile spreading across the face

meaning.en: Beaming with joy.
meaning.zh: 笑得使脸上的表情舒展开来。形容满脸笑容，十分高兴。

examples.zh: 听说丰收了，农民们笑逐颜开。
examples.en: Hearing of the bumper harvest, the farmers were all smiles.

examples.zh: 收到礼物，孩子笑逐颜开。
examples.en: The child beamed on getting the present.
